resources.string: Oro ā-rohe anake. Kāore he pānui, kāore he ine mamao, kāore he uru whatunga.\nNgā hōputu tautokohia: FLAC, M4A, M4B, MP3, OGG, Opus, WAV
Kāore te taurangi ōrite e wātea ana i runga i tēnei tūāpapa.
Me whakaae ki te uru oro i runga i te Android
Kāore he kōpaki kua tāpirihia. Pāwhiria \"Tāpiri kōpaki\" kia tīmata.
Ngā puna o te whare pukapuka

Whakamua i ngā hēkona tekau mā rima
Huri whakamuri i runga i te CV
Whai muri i te whakatā mō te kotahi meneti, ka tīmata anō ngā ara puoro e roa ake ana i te rua tekau meneti i ngā hēkona ruarua i mua.
Tākaro tonu ina hono ngā taringa whakarongo, ngā kaikorero motokā rānei.

Ia wā ka hono ngā taringa whakarongo ahokore Bluetooth (hei tauira, i roto i te motokā), ngā taringa whakarongo taura rānei, ngā taringa whakarongo USB rānei, ka tīmata te purei. Ka mahi i te wā e tuwhera ana te Retro Player, i te wā rānei e whakatā ana i roto i te pānui.

Ka whakakorehia e tēnei ngā tūranga purei, ngā tino pai, te kōpaki kua whakatuwherahia, te kaupapa, te reo, me ngā tautuhinga taurite oro. Mā te whakakore i ngā mea katoa ka wareware hoki i ngā kōpaki whare pukapuka kua tāpirihia. Kāore ngā kōnae puoro me ngā rārangi puoro kei runga kōpae e mukua.
Me puritia ngā kōpaki o te whare pukapuka
Ka puritia e Retro Player ngā tautuhinga o te taupānga ki roto i tētahi pātengi raraunga iti ā-rohe. Ka noho tonu ō waiata me ō rārangi waiata hei kōnae noa i roto i ngā kōpaki kua tohua e koe.

Kōnae: %1$s
Ara: %2$s

Ngā whakaritenga mō te whare pukapuka, te tirohanga tirotiro, te whakahoki purei, te taurite oro, te kaupapa, me ngā kōwhiringa reo.
Kāore ngā kōnae oro e kapehia ki roto i te pātengi raraunga o te taupānga. Tāpiri i ngā kōpaki whare pukapuka, ā, ka pānui a Retro Player i ngā kōnae tika mai i te kōpae.
He kōnae .m3u noa ngā rārangi puoro e puritia ana i roto i ō kōpaki whare pukapuka. Ka taea e koe te whakatika i a rātou i roto i te taupānga, i tētahi kaiwhakatika kuputuhi rānei.
Ngā whakaaetanga me te rokiroki o Android

Ka penapenahia e Retro Player tana pātengi raraunga ki te wāhi tautoko tūmataiti o te taupānga i runga i te rokiroki ā-roto. Ka noho tonu ō kōnae puoro ki ngā kōpaki ka tīpako koe mā te kaiwhiri kōpaki pūnaha.

Ka rere te oro, ka whakahaere a Retro Player i tētahi ratonga pāpāho o mua kia haere tonu te purei ahakoa ka raka koe i te waea pūkoro, ka huri rānei koe i ngā taupānga, ā, kei te pānui pūnaha ngā whakahaere kawe. Mā te pana i te taupānga kia puta atu i ngā Tauhokohoko o Nāianei ka mutu te purei, ka tangohia hoki te pānui.
Kei te rokiroki ngā raraunga taupānga i te wāhi tautoko tūmataiti o te taupānga i runga i te rokiroki ā-roto.
Kāore he rārangi. Tāpiri waiata mai i tō whare pukapuka.
